description: Lifecycle Lufy local, acotado y privacy-first para Codex.

hooks.command: sh -c 'if command -v lufy-ai >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec lufy-ai lifecycle codex; else printf "%s\n" "{\"continue\":true,\"systemMessage\":\"LUFY lifecycle unavailable: install lufy-ai or disable this project hook.\"}"; fi'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-Command lufy-ai -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { lufy-ai lifecycle codex } else { Write-Output '{\"continue\":true,\"systemMessage\":\"LUFY lifecycle unavailable: install lufy-ai or disable this project hook.\"}' }"
